main_text.p: Hæc ênixa iugo cupressifera CyllenesIde Fast.li.v.Æthereum volucri qui pede carpit iter.
Arcades hunc, Laddónque rapax, & Mænalus ingensRite colunt, Lunâ credita terra prior.
main_text.head: Erasinus fluuius.

p.i: Existit procul hinc, aliòque renascitur ore:
Sic modo combibitur, tecto modo gurgite lapsus
Reddit Argolicis ingens Erasinus in agris.
Et missum capitisque sui, ripaeque prioris
Pœnituisse, aliáque ferunt nunc ire Caicum.
Arcadia capita alta madent: ruit agmine facto
Inachus, & gelidas surgens Erasinus ad Arctos.
Spumeus, & genero tumuit Ioue quos celer ambit
Asterion, Dryopúmque trahens Erasinus aristas.

main_text.head: Styx fluuius Arcadiæ, de quo intelligenda sunt, quæ poetæ de Styge inferna scripserunt.

p.i: Dij, quibus in numerum vacui samulantur Auerni,
Vulgus iners, opibus quorum donatur auaris,
Quicquid in orbe perit, quos Styx liuentibus ambit
Inter fusa vadis, & quos fumantia torquens
Æquora, vorticibus Phlegethon perlustrat anhelis.
Quo bruta tellus, & vagaslumina,
Quo Styx, & inuisi horrida Tænari
Sedes, Atlanteúsque finis
Concutitur.
Quos circum limus niger, & deformis arundo
Cocyti tardáque palus, inamabilis vnda
Alligat, & nouies Styx interfusa coërcet.

page.notes: Marginal references are partly blurred; the notes "Ide Fast.li.v." and "Tænarus pro promontorium" and "Virgil.lib.4. Georg." are read with some doubt. Verse lines are printed in italic and are set as paragraphs by stanza; the Greek-style words "Phlegethon" and "Tænari" follow the print. Some letters in the marginal notes are uncertain.
